key_nodes: GeometryNodeFieldAtIndex — domain='POINT', data_type='FLOAT': pure field node, reads per-vertex 'altitude' at integer indices supplied by EdgeVertices
GeometryNodeInputEdgeVertices — outputs Vertex Index 1/2 (INT, EDGE domain) and Position 1/2 (FLOAT_VECTOR, EDGE domain)
ShaderNodeTexNoise + GeometryNodeSetPosition — Z-axis displacement creates altitude variation across the sphere
GeometryNodeStoreNamedAttribute('altitude', POINT, FLOAT) — materialises displaced Z before Field at Index reads it
ShaderNodeMath(SUBTRACT) — gradient_raw = altitude_v2 − altitude_v1; negative=downhill, positive=uphill
ShaderNodeMapRange(−GRAD_MAX, +GRAD_MAX → 0, 1) + ShaderNodeValToRGB — blue/white/red slope colour ramp
GeometryNodeStoreNamedAttribute('vertex_slope', POINT, FLOAT_COLOR) — vertex colour for shader read
